sites.functional_impact_measured: NOT MEASURED in L1; surface display confirmed by immunostaining in related HA-SDC4 constructs (L8/L9).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly names the junction as between amino acids 27 and 28 of human SDC4. Position 27 (I) and 28 (D) are both within the extracellular domain (residues 19-149), 9 residues into the ectodomain from the signal peptide cleavage site, and 122 residues from the TM boundary—well clear of all constraints. Python confirms residue_before=I, residue_after=D. Full-length human SDC4 construct with HA-tag inserted between amino acids 27 and 28, expressed in mammalian cells; the paper explicitly states the junction residues.

sources.claim: Where indicated, tagged constructs were used, where the FLAG-tag in human MLP was placed at the C-terminus, and the HA-tag in human syndecan-4 was placed between amino acids 27 and 28 at the N-terminus.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface localization confirmed by immuno-EM (L4); no functional assay reported for the tagged construct.
sites.rationale: L2 explicitly states the HA-tag is fused after amino acid 32 in the extracellular domain of full-length SDC4. Position 32 (L) and 33 (L) are within the extracellular domain (19-149), 14 residues into the ectodomain, and 117 residues from the TM boundary. L4 (same paper) confirms plasma membrane localization by immuno-EM. Python confirms residue_before=L, residue_after=L. Full-length SDC4 construct with HA-tag fused into the extracellular domain after amino acid 32, gifted from John Couchman (University of Copenhagen); plasma membrane localization confirmed by immuno-EM in bovine muscle cells.

sources.claim: Syndecan-4-HA: The HA-tag was fused into the extracellular domain after aa 32, and was a gift from John Couchman, University of Copenhagen, Denmark [ 16 ].

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: RT-qPCR: no difference in relative gene expression between HA-tagged and untagged SDC4 constructs (L6). Surface localization confirmed by fluorescence microscopy (L5).
sites.rationale: L5 and L7 (PMC13050698) describe an HA-tagged SDC4 with the tag at the N-terminus of the extracellular domain, but no specific residue is named. SDC4 has a signal peptide spanning residues 1-18 and a single extracellular N-terminus beginning at residue 19; the tag must therefore follow the signal peptide cleavage site (after residue 18, before residue 19). This is the only extracellular N-terminal position possible. Python confirms residue_before=A (pos 18, last of SP), residue_after=E (pos 19, mature N-terminus). Full-length HA-tagged SDC4 construct with HA-tag described as located 'in the N-terminus of the extracellular domain' (L7) and detected by 'antibody against the N-terminal HA-tag' (L5); expressed in SL-29 cells with surface localization confirmed by fluorescence microscopy. RT-qPCR shows no difference in SDC4 gene expression between tagged and untagged constructs (L6).

sources.claim: To investigate the cellular localization of SDC4 in embryonic chicken fibroblasts, Hemagglutinin (HA)-tagged SDC4 plasmid was transiently transfected into SL-29 cells and visualized with an antibody against the N-terminal HA-tag, or with a custom-made antibody recognizing the C-terminal of SDC4, in a fluorescence microscope.

literature_notes: Nine ledger lines were evaluated. L1 (PMC11172336) and L2 (PMC4467083) each explicitly name a junction residue (27 and 32, respectively) and are classified as validated. L5/L6/L7 (PMC13050698) describe an N-terminal HA-tag on full-length SDC4 with surface localization and preserved expression confirmed, but name no residue; the only possible extracellular N-terminal position is after the signal peptide cleavage site (after residue 18), giving a topology_derived site. L3 (PMC4467083) describes a GFP-tagged SDC4 construct with surface localization but specifies neither the terminus nor a residue; since the same paper already pins aa32 (L2) and the GFP terminus is ambiguous (N-terminal would be extracellular, C-terminal would be intracellular), L3 is used as supporting evidence for L2 rather than a separate site. L4 (PMC4467083) confirms plasma membrane localization of the HA-tagged construct by immuno-EM, supporting L2. L8 and L9 (PMC7157938) confirm surface display of HA-tagged SDC4 by immunostaining but name no residue; they support the topology_derived site at residue 18 but L5 is used as the primary clip. No intracellular or function-abrogating positions were reported in the ledger.
